observations: The no-router mixed index produces measurable cross-domain contamination, especially for aerospace component/condition queries.
S210 queries remain stable in this candidate-only baseline, while aerospace queries lose recall against the larger mixed corpus.
This is evidence that a scope or router experiment is warranted; it is not yet evidence for a particular router implementation.
The mixed baseline uses an evaluation-only composition adapter and does not modify the Generic Pipeline.
next_experiment: Compare no-router mixed retrieval with explicit metadata scope and, only if needed, a domain router; keep the same queries and report WrongDomain@1/@3/@5 and DomainPurity@K.
